contentSurface.purpose: Standalone readable content panel. Owns surface background, border, radius and surface shadow; padding is an explicit prop.
contentSurface.businessRule: Use PPSurface when a region is semantically a standalone content panel instead of recreating rounded+border+surface anatomy in each page.

workspaceRegion.purpose: Structural tool region inside a workspace; may remain a semantic region without card chrome.
workspaceRegion.rule: Do not add rounded/border/background merely to make every region look like a card.

inspector.purpose: Object/detail inspection region; pattern owns its chrome when introduced with multiple consumers.

tableFrame.purpose: Dense table/list framing; may use table-specific separators rather than PPSurface.

promotionRule: Create a new public pattern only after at least two real consumers share stable behavior/anatomy.
